name: Docleatae
land: the valley of the Zeta, inland
notes: DRAFT. The largest tribe of the hinterland, around Doclea: shepherds and farmers of the valley.

name: Labeatae
land: the shore south of the gulf, by the Labeatan lake
notes: DRAFT. The people of King Gentius, whose fleet Rome broke at Scodra in 168 BC: boatmen and fishers of the coast and the great lake.

name: Pirustae
land: the iron mountains of the north
notes: DRAFT. Mountain miners, the last to give in when Rome took Illyricum; famous for their iron and their pride.
